provider: NASA JPL / NASA Land Processes DAAC (LP DAAC)
product: ECOSTRESS Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Instantaneous L2 Global 70 m
attribution: Hook, S., Hulley, G. (2022). ECOSTRESS Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Instantaneous L2 Global 70 m V002. NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L2T_LSTE.002
method: Mean of valid pixels whose centres fall in each res-6 cell inside the region box. ECOSTRESS L2T LSTE v002 70 m land surface (skin) temperature, cloud-masked with the granule's cloud layer; one column per overpass date (tiles of the same pass combined). Single instantaneous snapshots at differing times of day.
sampling: mean of pixel centres in cell
